g.text: GPU: AMD Radeon 890M | NPU power snapshots: default (batch snapshots)
Bars: sample p10–p90, not confidence intervals. Open circle: sampled latency minimum; diamond: sampled speedup maximum.
These choices may differ under baseline drift; neither is a global optimum. Speedup ranges use paired sample ratios; repeats are not pooled.
